personajes.en: Mestiza woman with sun-weathered skin, dark hair in a low bun under a wide straw hat, wearing a plaid shirt, rolled jeans and rubber boots, holding a small woven coffee basket over her shoulder.
Lean mestizo man with short black hair, warm brown skin, wearing a casual blue windbreaker, jeans and sneakers, helmet strap in hand, his motorcycle keychain with a small woven guadua charm visible.
Afro-Colombian man with gray-flecked short beard, stocky build, wearing a checked short-sleeve shirt tucked into trousers with sandals, carrying a canvas money pouch and a small scale in hand.
Young Indigenous Nasa man with straight dark shoulder-length hair, copper-toned skin, wearing a plain hoodie, backpack and sneakers, holding a phone and a woven wristband on one arm.
Mestiza woman with silver hair in a tidy bob, glasses on a chain, wearing a light floral blouse, pressed trousers and low heeled shoes, carrying a small sewing kit pouch and a retirement ID folder.
Dark-skinned Afro-Colombian man with close-cropped hair, wearing a faded yellow hard hat, sleeveless undershirt, work trousers and rubber boots, holding a masonry trowel and measuring tape.
Mestiza woman with braided black hair, medium brown skin, wearing a simple cotton blouse, dark skirt and flat shoes, holding a notebook and a dry-erase marker, a school lanyard around her neck.
Elderly mestizo man with white mustache, deep wrinkles and weathered skin, wearing an old felt hat, long-sleeve gray shirt, dark trousers and worn leather sandals, leaning on a wooden cane.
